ops.body: Nov 21: the mock-up approved by the owner, "Approve, chevron left out at 320 (Recommended)": the bar as drawn, the time alone on its line, and at 320 px the red dot kept and the chevron left out (decision 0252). It is built as drawn.
Nov 21: the mock-up approved by the owner, "Approve as drawn (Recommended)" (decision 0252). It is built as drawn.
